purpose: Add a reproducible TimeMachine-style four-path Mamba baseline and its AutoCon counterpart to a fresh multivariate screen without mixing historical artifacts.
research_question: Does a four-path multi-direction Mamba improve or preserve the plain Mamba accuracy/speed trade-off, and does the AutoCon representation objective remain useful with the same forecasting path?
evidence_boundary: Unauthorized exploratory screen. It is not a paper result and cannot be concatenated with historical corrected, high-dimensional, or fair-screen artifacts.
claim_boundary: Report paired validation metrics, parameter counts, and resource smoke only. Do not claim universal accuracy, non-inferiority, or end-to-end speed before a fresh confirmation matrix.

phases.name: timemachine_plain_and_autocon_h96
phases.purpose: Fresh H96 multivariate screen for modern plain baselines, single-path Mamba, four-path TimeMachine Mamba, and matched AutoCon arms.

comparison_contract.interpretation: Use paired seed deltas within each dataset. Sliding windows and channels are not independent replicates. Plain and AutoCon rows are separate estimands.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This screen can select a candidate and expose dataset dependence; it cannot establish a final accuracy or speed claim. A fresh multi-horizon five-seed confirmation plan is required.
